facts.text: I've never had real food. Joi cooks dinner for me every night. It looks perfect. It just isn't there.
facts.why: Invented line signed Officer K. Deckard's real food line in the casino is 'Many is the night I dream of cheese. Toasted, mostly.'
facts.fix: Many is the night I dream of cheese. Toasted, mostly.

fix_note.text: Many is the night I dream of cheese. Toasted, mostly.

facts.text: The small wooden horse K carves into his memory.
facts.why: K does not carve the horse. It is a memory of a wooden toy horse he later finds in the orphanage furnace.
facts.fix: The small wooden horse K finds in the orphanage furnace

facts.text: Deckard pours one for the dog too.
facts.why: Deckard offers K whiskey ('millions of bottles') but nothing shows him pouring one for a dog.
facts.fix: Deckard has whiskey, millions of bottles.

facts.text: Joi, a hologram who cooks for him
facts.why: Joi, K's holographic girlfriend, prepares a virtual dinner for him, so she cooks for him in the hologram sense.

facts.text: Sapper's pot, still going on the stove.
facts.why: Sapper Morton runs a protein farm and says he grows garlic just for himself. No pot on a stove is shown.
facts.fix: Sapper's garlic, grown just for himself.
